description.zh: 将要转入的目标资源组ID。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the resources.

description.zh:
将要转移的资源列表。

> 每次最多转移10个资源。多个资源请分批转移。
description.en:
The resources that you want to move.

>  You can move a maximum of 10 resources at a time. If you want to move more than 10 resources, move them in batches.

descriptions.zh:
支持跨地域、跨云服务、跨资源组批量转移资源。

支持转移资源组的云服务，请参见[支持资源组的云服务](~~94479~~)的**API**列。
descriptions.en:
For more information about Alibaba Cloud services whose resources can be moved between resource groups, see the **Supported by the API** column in [Alibaba Cloud services that support resource groups](~~94479~~).

In this example, two virtual private clouds (VPCs) `vpc-bp1sig0mjktx5ewx1****` and `vpc-bp1visxm225pv49dz****` that reside in different regions and belong to different resource groups are moved to the resource group `rg-aekzmeobk5w****`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager move-resources --resource-group-id rg-aekzmeobk5w0000 --resources ResourceId=i-23v380000 Service=ecs ResourceType=instance RegionId=cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager MoveResources --region cn-hangzhou --Resources.1.ResourceId 'i-23v380000' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekzmeobk5w0000' --Resources.1.Service ecs --Resources.1.RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Resources.1.ResourceType instance --method POST --force
